name: Earshot AI
description: Paid iPhone app for on-device text, speech, photo and text-based document translation, local history and bilingual PDF export. US$4.99 once. iOS 17+. No account or subscription. Speech depends on local language resources. Scanned PDFs are unsupported. Bundled-model use excludes the EU, UK and South Korea, including travel. Unavailable in mainland China's App Store. The site has an actual edited build-19 simulator demo and its exported PDF.
